_note: MEASURED LIVE. Starters is a row on the Brand root and the gallery is one
click away, so nothing here is probed.
VERIFIED, not asserted: the row opens, the destination is this board, a
starter APPLIES, and the tokens change. surfaces/brand-dirty.json is the other
half of that walk — `starter-card-stripe-blue` was clicked live and the panel
came back dirty, which is what `useApplyStarter` -> `stageTokens` is supposed
to do. What it also does is documented there and is a real defect: in Beginner
mode the applied starter empties the Brand preview, because no starter token
carries `semanticKind` and Beginner filters on exactly that.
WHAT THE BOARD WON:
the warning's WORDS. It shipped as one line — "Applying a starter overwrites
your tokens." — against the board's four-clause paragraph (152:145), and the
short version got the frightening part backwards: it reads as immediate and
irreversible, and applying is neither. Every clause of the board's sentence
is true of `useApplyStarter`: `stageTokens` writes the CSS custom properties
on `documentElement` at once (the canvas preview), clears `undoStack` and
`redoStack` (per-token undo), touches only the colour, spacing and type
registries (the other eleven kinds keep their values), and persists nothing
until the Review modal — the confirm that names every staged edit — reaches
`setProjectSettings`. Checked clause by clause before adopting it; copy that
describes behaviour has to be true or the board does not get to win.
warning block   a full-bleed 12/8 strip -> the board's rounded-8 callout on
16/14 gutters at a 150 floor (152:144).
card            `gap-1.5` and a fixed 104 height (152:148). The caption's
6px used to be a padding on the label, which measures the
same and states something different, and `h-auto` left the
card at 100 so the three rows drifted 4px each.
thumb radius    0 -> 6 (152:149).
caption         12/18 (152:150). The line was inherited from flowbite's
`text-sm` on the Button, which is 20 and only right at 14px.
NOT CONFORMED — the thumb FILL (152:149 and its five siblings):
the board fills all six thumbs a flat `--color/bg-subtle`. That is a
placeholder, not a decision: six identical grey rectangles would leave the
gallery with nothing to tell Stripe Blue from Linear Dark but the caption
under it, and the caption is the one thing the board already has. The code
paints each starter's own `color-primary` -> `color-background`, which is
the card's only differentiator. Board sample data is never conformed to
literally (founder, 2026-08-06) and a placeholder fill for content is that.
The six thumb nodes are therefore SKIPPED — their height and radius ARE
conformed in code, they just cannot be joined without the fill coming with
them. Founder can overrule; it is one line in StarterGrid.tsx.
NOT JOINED:
152:145, the warning paragraph — `width: 248px` against a measured 247. The
panel is `--bk-size-drawer` 280 and `.ls-panel` spends 1px of it on
`border-right`, so the content box is 279 and a 16/16 inset leaves 247. The
board draws its own 1px frame border and then measures 248 = 280 - 32 inside
it, which is the board ignoring its own edge. Pinning the paragraph to a
literal 248 would break the widened drawer (`--drawer-w` is 560 for Media,
700 expanded), so the shape — 16 in from both sides — is what the code
satisfies. Its colour, 11px size and 16px line all match and are visible in
measured/brand-starters.json.
152:147 / 152:154 / 152:161, the three `row` frames — the gallery is a CSS
grid, so there is no per-row element to anchor. Their only property is
`gap: 16`, which the grid states once and 152:146 measures.
152:137 itself — the drawer's edge, see brand-lint-warnings.json.
HEADER TITLE REVERSED TO THE BOARD: the panel header now reads `Brand` at
every depth, not `Brand › <Section>`. Six destination frames state the title
text and all six say `Brand`; check-board-copy.mjs reported it on all six at
